nodes.description: Private owner address set in constructor from msg.sender; used as privileged auth check in delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of token balances; written by transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances; written by approve and transferFrom.
Address whitelisted in ensure() as an allowed sender; set by setTradeAddress.
Mapping marking addresses allowed to sell without restriction; set to true by _mints.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Minimum sale amount set by init and enforced in condition.
Maximum sale amount set by init and enforced in condition.
Allowed number of sales per address set by init and enforced in condition.
Total token supply assigned in the constructor.
Constant 18 used for scaling in _mints, init and the constructor.
Constant Uniswap router address compared against _from in ensure().
Caller-controlled address used both as authorization principal and as token holder.
Public payable transfer; forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as sender.
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance check, ensure() gate, balance arithmetic and _onSaleNum increment.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][spender].
Internal view gate that whitelists owner, UNI pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses else enforces condition().
Internal view sale-limit checker on _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied address and payload.
Whitelisted mint-like setter that overwrites balanceOf[spender] and marks canSale[spender].
Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only loop sending _value to each address in _tos with unchecked multiplication for the total.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress state variable.
Internal pure Uniswap-V2 style pair address derivation used by ensure().
Payable constructor initializing supply, owner balance and infinite router allowance.
Low-level delegatecall in delegate() executing arbitrary code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked subtraction of allowance and balanceOf plus additions in transferFrom.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Unchecked multiplication addedValue * 10**decimals in _mints.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender of the transferFrom call in transfer.
msg.sender is checked against _from to decide whether allowance must be spent in transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller identity.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before the delegatecall.
_mints gates balance overwrite on a hardcoded msg.sender whitelist.
init requires msg.sender == owner before setting sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before the mass transfer loop.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
constructor assigns owner and full supply to msg.sender.
_to is the recipient parameter consumed by transfer.
_value is the amount parameter consumed by transfer.
_from is the source parameter consumed by transferFrom.
_to is the recipient parameter consumed by transferFrom.
_value is the amount parameter consumed by transferFrom.
_from is the sender parameter examined by ensure.
_to is the recipient parameter examined by ensure.
_value is the amount forwarded from ensure to condition.
_from indexes _onSaleNum in condition.
_value is compared with _minSale and _maxSale in condition.
Target address a flows into the delegatecall destination.
Calldata b flows into the delegatecall payload.
spender is the account written in balanceOf and canSale by _mints.
addedValue is scaled and written to balanceOf by _mints.
saleNum is stored into _saleNum by init.
token is scaled into _minSale by init.
maxToken is scaled into _maxSale by init.
_tos provides the recipients and length used in batchSend.
_value is multiplied by _tos.length and credited in batchSend.
addr is stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
factory is hashed into the pair address in pairFor.
tokenA is ordered and hashed in pairFor.
tokenB is ordered and hashed in pairFor.
_name initializes the name state variable in the constructor.
_symbol initializes the symbol state variable in the constructor.
_supply is scaled into totalSupply in the constructor.
transfer immediately delegates to transferFrom with msg.sender as source.
transferFrom calls ensure to authorize the transfer before mutating balances.
ensure falls back to condition for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure derives the pair address through pairFor.
ensure reads owner as a whitelist bypass.
ensure compares _from against the constant UNI router.
ensure compares _from against tradeAddress.
ensure consults canSale for the sender.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] with _saleNum.
condition enforces the _minSale lower bound.
condition enforces the _maxSale upper bound.
condition reads the sender sale counter _onSaleNum.
transferFrom validates and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom decrements the sender balance and increments the recipient balance.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
allowance and balance updates in transferFrom are unchecked arithmetic.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no zero-allowance protection.
delegate forwards user-controlled address and calldata to a delegatecall.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] without adding to it.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, granting unrestricted selling.
_mints scales addedValue by 10**decimals.
addedValue * 10**decimals is an unchecked multiplication.
init sets _minSale from the token parameter.
init sets _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init sets _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
init scales limits using 10**decimals.
batchSend debits the owner balance and credits every recipient.
total = _value * _tos.length is an unchecked multiplication.
setTradeAddress overwrites the tradeAddress state variable.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
constructor assigns totalSupply from the scaled _supply.
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
constructor grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
_UNI local holds the pairFor result used in the ensure whitelist.
total local holds the computed batch cost in batchSend.
i is the iteration index of batchSend.
_to is the per-iteration recipient in batchSend.
token0 local stores the ordered lower token in pairFor.
token1 local stores the ordered higher token in pairFor.
pair local holds the derived pair address returned by pairFor.
